notes: All 37 source and 43 target ids are partitioned exactly once.

The object marker at s014 takes in under rule 16's first family: the ASV spends that word on the object relation of ministering and nothing else in the clause licenses it. Rule 44's supplied-preposition clause is expressly limited where a marker is present, so the word does not go to the verb.
At s036, by contrast, the Hebrew writes a bare suffixed object, so the unto of minister unto them belongs to the verb's unit under rule 44.
The assimilated article at s027 is a real token under rule 12 and takes the written the before people.
